### Known gaps

- QuotaUtilization: 61 of the 3307 count-of-resources quotas (internal/app/testdata/service_quota_classes.json classes c and e) report live usage; the other 3246 (per-instance-type usage of SageMaker, Bedrock, Connect, Glue, CloudFront, Spot-fleet style quotas and the remaining quotas of every documented service) have no counter in internal/app/service_quotas_counters.go; the 1411 rate, throughput and concurrency quotas (class r) report no usage because the emulator keeps no request-rate or concurrency meter, and the 217 size and length quotas (class s) are per-request limits with nothing to count
- AppliedQuotaEnforcement: opt-in (--enforce-service-quotas) for S3 buckets, EC2 Elastic IPs, VPCs, subnets per VPC, internet gateways, security groups, rules per security group, route tables per VPC, NAT gateways per AZ, network interfaces, routes per table and On-Demand vCPUs (RunInstances, every class) and Spot vCPUs (RequestSpotInstances, Standard, G and VT and P), IAM roles/users/groups/customer managed policies/instance profiles, EKS clusters, DynamoDB tables, RDS DB instances and clusters, CloudFormation stacks, ALB/NLB/Classic load balancers, CloudWatch Logs log groups, KMS keys/aliases per key/grants per key, EventBridge buses/rules per bus/connections/endpoints/API destinations, Step Functions state machines/activities/versions/aliases, Route 53 hosted zones/health checks/delegation sets/traffic policies/CIDR collections, ECR repositories, Auto Scaling groups and launch configurations, EFS file systems, Firehose delivery streams and Cognito identity and user pools; counted but not enforced: ECS clusters (CreateCluster declares no limit exception), Route 53 records per hosted zone (ChangeResourceRecordSets declares none), and vCPUs launched through Spot Fleet, Auto Scaling or launch templates (only RunInstances and RequestSpotInstances check them); rate quotas never throttle

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- Support staff never review a case: a request still auto-approves on the lifecycle dwell unless its Support case is resolved first (CASE_CLOSED).
